fields.Name: T081 - Grid View-Type Switch to Timeline
fields.Description: The timeline-view-renderer plots records on a date axis — a distinct renderer code path from both the AG-Grid table and the cards renderer, gated by the entity having a date field.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and go to Data Explorer > Data. Open the 'Events' entity (or 'Products') via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box (type the name, click the exact match). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Open the view-type switcher dropdown in the view toolbar. If 'Timeline' is offered, select it and confirm the records re-render along a chronological timeline axis. (Timeline only appears for entities that expose a date field; if it is not offered, selecting another type such as 'Cards' and seeing the view re-render is an acceptable outcome.)

judgeValidationCriteria: The view-type switcher lists multiple types; if 'Timeline' is offered, selecting it renders a chronological/timeline layout
If Timeline is not available, an alternate type (e.g. Cards) is selectable and the view re-renders, OR a valid empty-state shows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
